left.text: Milo found a tiny light under a leaf. “I am Glow,” it said. “I cannot find my home.”

right.text: “I will help,” said Milo. “What is your home like?” “Tall grass beside a little pond,” said Glow.

left.text: They looked behind the flowers. No pond. They looked beside the carrots. No tall grass. Glow’s light grew small.

right.text: “We can rest,” said Milo. They sat beside a stone wall. Then Milo heard a soft sound. Plip. Plop.

left.text: “Water!” said Milo. He found a low gap in the wall. But the path beyond it was dark.

right.text: “I can shine,” said Glow. Milo followed the little light. Together, they found the pond and its tall grass.

left.text: Tiny lights blinked in the grass. “My family!” cried Glow. Milo smiled. Then he looked back at the dark path.

right.text: “We will help you home,” said Glow. Little lights danced beside Milo, all the way to his garden gate.
